name: Music Ledger
description: Full-screen monospace ledger of releases where hovering a row scrambles its text, highlights the cells and fades in a cover image behind the list, with a pulsing idle animation.
contents: Row list with index, artist, album, category, label and year
behavior: Hover or focus on a row scrambles its text and reveals a zoom-in background image while other rows dim
After an idle delay a GSAP timeline pulses the rows in a looping wave
Category, label and year columns are hidden below 768px
editableByProps: All row text and background images, number of rows
Background, text, accent and border colors as Tailwind classes
Font, scramble characters and timing, idle animation timing, noise and scanlines

needsCodeEdit.where: COLUMNS constant and the ScrambleCell elements in the list
grid-cols classes on the li element

fixed: Noise and scanline overlays and the background image layer are position fixed to the viewport
Root is at least one viewport tall and centers the list
Hover reveal is triggered by focus on touch devices through tap
